copy.headline: CMC GETS RICKROLLED
copy.dek: In the pun-name showdown, @alysson2114 never gave anything up, and @Wasabi209 doesn't even roster CMC.
copy.hero_caption: Never gonna run around. Just straight through.
copy.story_title: Gibbs You Up Hits Every Note, The (P)Rice Bids Wrong, and Nabers Find the Basement
story: The pun-name showdown went exactly like the song. @alysson2114 never gave up a thing, as Jahmyr Gibbs and D'Andre Swift turned one backfield into a five-touchdown karaoke night and left @Wasabi209 deserted on the dance floor. Colston Loveland caught nothing while the Bears' offense exploded around him, and the rest of You'll Never CMC Me Again mostly hummed along. One commissioner down, one to go.

The other commish, @jmass, won comfortably and still botched the showcase: The (P)Rice is Right started Terry McLaurin (3.4) over Jalen Coker (33.8), the fantasy version of spinning the Big Wheel and landing on five cents. Nobody tell Drew Carey. @sedwards1495 beat @kellengil with the week's seventh-best score and a trophy shelf that argues with itself, Kenneth Walker hogging one end while Ja'Marr Chase sulks at the other. @EaglesRx posted the fifth-best score and lost anyway, because @alexeldeib's waiver-wire kicker and defense outscored the margin by themselves. And @ActuallyLogan's lineup wasted barely a crumb in a cruise past @TurkeyTime1.

Down in the basement, @nseldeib and @kellengil finished 0.12 apart in different games, a photo finish for nobody's prize. It's one week, so nobody gets fitted for a crown or a coffin yet. But the table already has a team to chase, and the group chat already has a song it can't get out of its head.

power_lines.line: Four starters cleared 20. The rest of La Liga should change the locks.
Chris Olave had 182 yards and no touchdown, somehow the scariest part.
Isaiah Likely topped ESPN's best plays in his Giants debut. A repeat seems, well, likely.
Christian Watson and Dalton Kincaid piled up 277 yards. Defenses need a bigger secondary.
The Rx for an unlucky week: same lineup, any other opponent.
Caleb and Bijan put up 68.56. Everyone else: come on down.
With Jaxson Dart going 23 of 29, this 1-0 looks aimed, not lucky.
Zay Flowers bloomed with a 54-yard score. Puka and A.J. Brown are still seeds.
George Kittle (3.2) and Harrison Mevis (1.0) sent this kitchen's order back raw.
Trevor Lawrence threw four touchdowns in a loss, which is as loca as football gets.
Montgomery and Taylor made 54.0. The other seven starters made 37.12 and excuses.
Malik Nabers hit his 12.9 projection exactly. Like a good neighbor, there as quoted.

award_lines.line: Five rushing touchdowns from one backfield. Mercy was a healthy scratch.
D'Andre Swift turned a 13.4 projection into 32.4. Definitely Taylor's Version.
Bo Nix (6.44) delivered exactly what his last name promised.
Evan McPherson (19.5) outkicked Brandon Aubrey (1.0) by most of the margin.
Left 1.8 points on the bench. Won't Rock, won't flinch.
Started Saquon on reputation. Reputation caught one pass for -3 yards.
Picked up Dontayvion Wicks and never lit him. 15.3 points, still in the wrapper.
Two touchdowns passing, two running. Caleb Williams did everything but punt.
Allen ran for two scores. From the bench, that's just cardio.
173 rushing yards. Kenneth Walker took the defense for a long walk.
Two catches, 12 yards. Somebody called off the Chase early.
Drew the one opponent leaving 86.40 on the bench. Impeccable scheduling.
Derrick Henry scored three times. Wrong week to draw the second-highest scorer.

game_lines.line: Justin Jefferson scored twice, then celebrated a two-pointer like the game was close.
Bijan had 90 receiving yards, more than Jameson Williams and McLaurin put together.
Dart threw three scores, then the Giants trolled Dallas with Sandy Cheeks. Yee-haw.
David Montgomery scored three times, matching Drake Maye's interception total.
Jeanty hurdled two Dolphins. Bucky Irving collided with two defenders and fumbled.
Kincaid dove onto TSN's top ten. Hurts threw three TDs, and it still hurt.

copy.news:
I found eight Week 1 moments involving players in your league, each confirmed by the NFL, a team or a major sports outlet. Two things to know first. The articles are dated about two weeks ago, so the season may be past Week 1 now. Also, I hit my search limit before I could look up every player, so some rosters aren't covered.

- **Isaiah Likely (Won't Rock):** In his first game for the Giants, he scored twice, including a 15-yard catch, in a 28-20 Sunday Night Football win over Dallas. ESPN put him at the top of its Week 1 best-plays roundup, and he was the team's red-zone threat that night. https://www.si.com/nfl/giants/onsi/isaiah-likely-shines-as-new-york-giants-top-dallas-cowboys-28-20-01m2ersn2671

- **Jaxson Dart (sedwards1495):** He went 23 of 29 for 230 yards and 3 TDs, and ran for 54 yards. According to ESPN Research, he's only the third Giants QB with 3 passing TDs and 50 rushing yards in one game. After the game, the Giants posted a "Yee-haw" video of the Texan SpongeBob character Sandy Cheeks to mock the Cowboys, and ESPN ranked it the top troll of Week 1. https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49933320/nfl-week-1-2026-trolls

- **Ashton Jeanty (Herbert's Hermanos):** He leaped over two Dolphins defenders, linebacker Jordyn Brooks and safety Zayne Anderson. The shot made the NFL's Top 10 Photos of Week 1. https://www.nfl.com/photos/top-10-photos-from-week-1-of-the-2026-season

- **Dalton Kincaid (PopPop4126):** He made a diving 38-yard catch that TSN ranked among the 10 best plays of Week 1. https://www.tsn.ca/nfl/video/2026/09/15/the-10-best-plays-from-week-1-in-the-nfl/

- **Zay Flowers (TurkeyTime1):** He turned a short pass into a 54-yard TD. NFL.com said his connection with Lamar Jackson looked "otherworldly" in a Ravens opener that wowed people. https://www.nfl.com/news/five-storylines-to-know-from-week-1-of-2026-nfl-season

- **Jordan Love (TurkeyTime1) vs. Justin Jefferson (Won't Rock):** Love fell apart and fumbled as Minnesota kept blitzing and Green Bay's line couldn't pick it up. Meanwhile, Jefferson was photographed celebrating a two-point conversion catch against the Packers. The same NFL.com recap noted that Colston Loveland (You'll Never CMC Me Again) had zero catches even though the Bears' offense exploded. https://www.nfl.com/news/2026-nfl-season-week-1-what-we-learned-from-sunday-s-games

- **Bucky Irving (EaglesRx):** He lost a fumble after colliding with two defenders. It was one of four Bucs fumbles that led to 24 points for the other team. https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49871987/week-1-sunday-games-takeaways-questions-2026

- **Justin Herbert (Herbert's Hermanos):** He was sacked three times, threw an interception and passed for only 209 yards. That got ESPN asking whether the Chargers were the most overhyped team of the offseason. https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49881129/week-1-overreactions-2026-graziano-lamar-jackson-bears-bryce-young-cj-stroud

Close calls I left out: Jonathan Taylor's fourth-quarter TD in the Colts' overtime win over the Chiefs, and Caleb Williams' TD pass to Cole Kmet, which TSN called "an absolute dart." I also skipped the Bears' Monday night rout of the Eagles because it was a later week, not Week 1.
